notes.title: PriOne Patch Note 0.0.3
notes.content:
Patch Note 0.0.3
---------------------
- Fix arrow Attach on hit
- Add ON Death Hud
- Add Craft in inventory / Press I > Craft
- Improve overall LOD for performance
- Add Perks System / Press I > Skill
- Add Thai Boxing Fight System /Equip knuckle in inventory and use item Press 1
- Improve Shoot Direction
- Add day/night and particle in War mode for test
- Switch aim camera / Press V When Aim
- Press ESC to exit in Game menu /Community Request
- Add Support us URL
